_comment: The starting character. name null = a random given name (data/names.json); gender is picked from genders; random_attributes: every attribute starts at base, then points are handed out one at a time to random attributes, none above max (8 + 10 points = the same total as before). Leave out random_attributes to use attributes as written. Money is in shards. faints_allowed: knockouts survived per hunt before death. equipped: item ids from the inventory that start wielded or worn. Attributes must match the list in game/stats.py. artifact_slot_count: how many artifacts can be equipped at once (they leave the bag). skills: skill id -> starting rank (data/skills.json). Inventory entries are item ids from items.json, or [id, count] for stacks. random_kit (if present) replaces inventory, equipped and shards for each new Hunter: one weapon set is picked from weapons (the first item is wielded; the rest, like arrows, go in the bag), one armour from armor (null = none), each supply gets a random count in [low, high], and shards a random amount in [low, high]. PLACEHOLDER choices and numbers.
